text: I am writing to apply for the position of weekend tour guide at Castlebury Museum, which I saw advertised in the Castlebury Herald last Friday.

For the past two years, I have worked part-time as a receptionist at the Royal Hotel, where I deal with international guests every day. I speak fluent English and Spanish, and I also have a good working knowledge of French, which I believe would be useful when showing visitors around.

I have been fascinated by local history since childhood, and I have visited the museum many times. In particular, I would enjoy telling visitors about the medieval collection, which I consider one of the most impressive in the region. I am confident that my enthusiasm would help visitors to enjoy their visit.
I am available every Saturday and Sunday, and I would also be able to work extra hours during the school holidays if necessary.
I would be delighted to attend an interview at a time convenient to you. Thank you for considering my application.

note.en: Adds where the job was advertised.
Specifies what the hotel job involves.
note.ru: Уточняет, что за работа в отеле.

note.en: Highlights what interests the writer most.
A condition: extra hours if needed.

strengths.en: The writer chooses only what a guide needs: work with guests and languages.
strengths.kk: Жазушы гидке керегін ғана таңдайды: қонақтармен жұмыс және тілдер.
strengths.ru: Пишущий выбирает только то, что пригодится гиду: работа с гостями и языки.
strengths.example: I deal with international guests every day

strengths.en: Not “I like history” but a specific collection and frequent visits.
strengths.kk: «I like history» емес, нақты коллекция және мұражайға жиі бару.
strengths.ru: Не «I like history», а конкретная коллекция и частые визиты в музей.
strengths.example: telling visitors about the medieval collection

strengths.en: “I believe” and “I am confident” show confidence without boasting.
strengths.ru: «I believe», «I am confident» — уверенность без хвастовства.
strengths.example: I am confident that my enthusiasm

strengths.en: No contractions and a standard ending for an application.
strengths.example: Thank you for considering my application.

note.en: No name is given, so the letter is formal: “Dear Sir or Madam”.
note.kk: Алушының аты жоқ — formal және «Dear Sir or Madam».
note.ru: Имени адресата нет — formal и «Dear Sir or Madam».

note.en: An application: the job and where it was advertised come in the first sentence.
note.kk: Өтініш хат: лауазымы және хабарландыруды қай жерден көргені — бірінші сөйлемде.
note.ru: Письмо-заявление: должность и где увидел объявление — в первой фразе.

note.en: Bullet 1: experience and skills that matter for a guide — dealing with visitors, languages.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — гид жұмысына қатысты тәжірибе мен дағдылар: туристермен сөйлесу, тілдер.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — опыт и навыки, связанные с работой гида: общение с туристами, языки.

note.en: Bullet 2: interest — a personal link with the museum and a specific collection.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — қызығушылық: мұражаймен жеке байланыс және нақты коллекция.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — интерес: личная связь с музеем и конкретная коллекция.

note.en: Bullet 3: availability, plus willingness to work extra hours.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — қашан жұмыс істей алады, сондай-ақ қосымша сағаттарға дайындық.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — когда может работать, плюс готовность к дополнительным часам.

note.en: Readiness for an interview and thanks.
note.ru: Готовность прийти на собеседование и благодарность.

note.en: “Dear Sir or Madam” is closed with “Yours faithfully” and a full name.
note.kk: «Dear Sir or Madam» хаты «Yours faithfully» және толық атымен аяқталады.
note.ru: «Dear Sir or Madam» закрывается «Yours faithfully» и полным именем.
